answer: If you ask the clockmaker how he knows a stranger is no clockmaker at all, he opens his escapement book and points at the entries. Clockmaker escapement record with clockmakers attestation: twelve-year record, 900 movements regulated, escapement trials, yearly fees. Present a copied cipher and the movement is refused, the applicant forfeits a bond worth twice the piece and the wander is struck from the register, while the voyage is kept on file and produced when the guild next sits.
